perks.name: Zen Moment

perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.desc: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.desc:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Rewind Rounds
perks.desc: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

perks.name: Impromptu Ammunition
perks.desc: Final blows increase ammo meter progress from all sources for a short time.

perks.name: Heal Clip
perks.desc: Reloading shortly after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies.

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.desc: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.desc: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

perks.name: Shield Disorient
perks.desc: Energy matched shield explosion disorients nearby combatants.

perks.name: Under Pressure
perks.desc: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.desc: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

perks.name: Onslaught
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon increase its rate of fire.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

perks.name: Burning Ambition
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.

perks.name: Firefly
perks.desc: Precision kills with this weapon increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby enemies.

perks.name: Disruption Break
perks.desc: Breaking an enemy's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for a brief period.

perks.name: Target Lock
perks.desc: Damage increases the longer this weapon remains on a target.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.desc: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Tap the Trigger
perks.desc: Grants a short period of increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.

perks.name: Mulligan
perks.desc: Missing a shot has a chance to return ammo directly to the magazine.

perks.name: Forge's Kin
perks.desc: Black Armory weapon final blows briefly grant ammo generation, reload speed, and damage against combatants when the weapon is redrawn. Buff potency and duration increases for each equipped Black Armory weapon.

notes: Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Solar-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly with Solar builds. The Ringing Nail is a precision auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "worse damage profile than balanced, but has barrier intrinsic". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, and a ×0.9 reduction in horizontal recoil, as per the Destiny Data Compendium. With the frame intrinsic, you don't really have to worry about Recoil Direction, so you can take your pick with the barrel perk to boost Handling, Stability or Range. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For a roll to clear both group and tougher individual adds, and which also synergises with Solar builds - In the first trait perk column, Incandescent spreads +30 Solar Scorch stacks within 4m on a red bar Minor add kill (+45 stacks within 8m for orange and yellow bars), with scorch damage counting as weapon damage so can inherit damage boosts, and also proc subclass fragments. In the second, you can use a scorch ability to make the most of Burning Ambition to build Solar ignitions on tougher targets. If you can't apply scorch first, it'll take ~19 hits within 2s of each other to apply +10 scorch stacks, with +10 added on each additional hit afterwards to build towards an ignition. All of the scorch stacks for both perks are increased by ×1.5 with Ember of Ashes. Aegis ranks the Forge's Kin origin trait as S-Tier for PvE - it provides a ×1 stack of "Forge's Kin" for 5s after a kill, or on swapping from another Black Armory weapon kill within 7s. Each additional Black Armory weapon equipped adds an additional stack, each boosting the activation window by +2s together with increasing Reload Speed and Ammo Generation, and applying damage boosts of ×1.1 for one or ×1.13 for two. If you're interested, the name is drawn from from the traditional art of blacksmithing and metallurgy. The phrase literally refers to the distinct, high-pitched acoustic resonance (the "ringing") produced when a blacksmith strikes a high-quality, hot metal nail or anvil with a hammer. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.
